description: Pre-built AI workflow templates for e-commerce businesses. Includes Shopify, WooCommerce, and platform-agnostic variants.

workflows.name: Order Status Auto-Response
workflows.description: Connect store order data to support tool — auto-respond to WISMO (Where Is My Order) queries

platform_agnostic.integration: Any platform with order API access

steps: Pull order status from store API using order ID or email
Fetch tracking info from carrier API (via Sendcloud/ShipStation if available)
Format tracking info into customer-friendly response
Auto-reply via support tool API or email
Log interaction for CS team visibility
prerequisites: Support tool with API (Gorgias, Zendesk, Tidio, or email)
workflows.eu_note: Must disclose AI interaction per EU AI Act (effective Aug 2026)

workflows.name: Smart Inventory Alert & Auto-Reorder
workflows.description: Monitor stock levels, trigger reorder workflows when thresholds are hit, and auto-generate purchase orders
workflows.trigger: Stock level drops below threshold for any SKU

platform_agnostic.integration: Any platform with inventory API + Picqer/Cin7 for WMS

steps: Monitor inventory levels via API polling or webhooks
Detect SKUs below reorder threshold
Calculate optimal reorder quantity from sales velocity and lead times
Auto-generate purchase order (or send reorder request to supplier/Slack)
Update inventory forecast dashboard
For multi-warehouse: optimize allocation across EU fulfillment centers

workflows.name: Automated Return Processing with Exchange-First Logic
workflows.description: Customer submits return → AI evaluates policy → suggest exchange → auto-approve or flag for review
steps: Parse return request details (order ID, reason, condition)
Check against return policy rules (timeframe, condition, value)
Suggest exchange first to retain revenue (63.5% retention rate from exchange-first strategies)
Auto-approve returns that meet policy criteria
Generate return shipping label via Sendcloud/ShipStation API
Send customer confirmation with label and instructions
Flag edge cases for human review
Track return reasons for product improvement insights
workflows.eu_note: EU mandates 14-day return right (Consumer Rights Directive). Right to Repair (July 2026) extends warranty 12 months if consumer chooses repair.

workflows.name: AI-Personalized Cart Recovery
workflows.description: Detect abandoned carts and send personalized recovery messages based on browsing context and cart value
steps: Detect abandoned cart events from webhooks
Analyze cart contents, value, and customer browsing history
Generate personalized recovery message with Claude API
Apply dynamic discount logic based on cart value and customer tier
Send via email (Klaviyo/Omnisend API) and/or SMS
Multi-step sequence: 1hr, 24hr, 72hr touchpoints
Track recovery rate and optimize messaging
prerequisites: Email or SMS tool with API
workflows.eu_note: GDPR requires explicit opt-in for cart recovery emails/SMS. Double opt-in standard in DE.

workflows.name: Automated Review Response
workflows.description: Monitor new reviews and draft personalized responses for owner approval
steps: Monitor review platforms for new reviews via API or webhook
Analyze sentiment and extract key themes
Draft personalized response matching brand voice with Claude API
Route to owner for quick approval or auto-post for positive reviews
Flag negative reviews for priority human response
Track review response rate and sentiment trends
prerequisites: Review platform with API (Yotpo, Judge.me, Google Business, or Trustpilot)
workflows.eu_note: EU Omnibus Directive (in force since 2022) requires transparency on review authenticity. AI-generated responses must be honest.

workflows.name: AI-Powered Collection Merchandising
workflows.description: Automatically sort and prioritize products within collections based on real-time sales data, inventory levels, and margins
workflows.trigger: Daily/hourly collection refresh or manual trigger
steps: Connect product catalog and sales data via API
Define merchandising rules (prioritize high-margin, demote out-of-stock, boost trending)
AI analyzes sales velocity, inventory, conversion rate, and margin per product
Auto-sort collection pages based on optimized ranking
Demote low-stock items to prevent overselling frustration
A/B test merchandising strategies
Report on revenue impact of sorting changes
workflows.note: Reduces manual merchandising time by 80-90%. Especially valuable during sales events and seasonal changes.

workflows.name: Predictive Restocking & Auto-PO
workflows.description: AI analyzes sales velocity, seasonality, and supplier lead times to auto-generate purchase orders before stockouts occur
workflows.trigger: Weekly forecast refresh or inventory drop below safety stock
steps: Ingest historical sales data (12+ months ideal)
Build demand forecast model accounting for seasonality, trends, promotions
Calculate safety stock levels per SKU based on lead time variability
Generate reorder recommendations when projected stock hits safety threshold
Auto-create purchase orders with optimized quantities
Route PO for approval or auto-send to supplier
Track forecast accuracy and adjust models
For EU multi-warehouse: optimize allocation across fulfillment centers
prerequisites: E-commerce store with 12+ months sales data
workflows.note: AI reduces forecasting errors by 20-50% and cuts lost sales by up to 65%. Critical for seasonal businesses.

workflows.name: Dynamic Pricing & Competitor Monitoring
workflows.description: Monitor competitor prices and automatically adjust pricing based on demand, inventory, and competitive positioning
workflows.trigger: Daily price check or competitor price change detected
steps: Connect competitor URLs or feeds to monitoring tool
Define pricing rules (match, beat by X%, maintain margin floor)
AI analyzes demand signals, inventory levels, and competitive landscape
Generate price adjustment recommendations per SKU
Apply changes via store API (with approval gate or auto-apply for low-risk changes)
Track margin impact and revenue changes
Alert on significant competitor price moves
workflows.eu_note: EU price transparency rules require showing original prices correctly in promotions.

workflows.name: AI Customer Segmentation & Lifecycle Marketing
workflows.description: Automatically segment customers by behavior, value, and lifecycle stage for targeted marketing campaigns
workflows.trigger: Weekly segment refresh or new customer milestone (first purchase, repeat, at-risk churn)
steps: Connect customer purchase history and behavior data
Build RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) segmentation model
Add AI predictive layers: churn risk, purchase propensity, predicted CLV
Create automated campaigns per segment (VIP, at-risk, win-back, new buyer nurture)
Personalize product recommendations per segment in emails
Track segment movement and campaign performance
Optimize based on conversion data
workflows.note: Advanced segmentation drives 3-5x email revenue per send vs batch-and-blast. Klaviyo flows generate 41% of email revenue from just 5.3% of sends.

workflows.name: AI Social Commerce Content Pipeline
workflows.description: Generate and optimize product content for TikTok Shop, Instagram Shopping, and social selling channels
workflows.trigger: New product launch, weekly content calendar, or trending topic detected
steps: Select products for social promotion (trending, high-margin, new arrivals)
Generate product images optimized for social platforms (Photoroom for backgrounds, Canva AI for layouts)
Create short-form video content from product photos/videos (Opus Clip, Synthesia)
Write AI-generated captions with trending hashtags (Claude API)
Schedule posts across platforms
Monitor engagement and sales attribution
Repurpose top-performing content across channels
workflows.note: Social commerce projected to surpass $100B in US alone by 2026. TikTok Shop growing 48% YoY.

workflows.name: EU Compliance Automation Dashboard
workflows.description: Automated monitoring and management of EU regulatory compliance across EAA, AI Act, GDPR, DSA, and consumer rights
workflows.trigger: Weekly compliance scan or regulatory change alert
steps: Set up automated accessibility scanning (WCAG 2.1 AA — EAA requirement)
Configure GDPR-compliant cookie consent management with equal-prominence reject button
Add AI interaction disclosure labels to chatbots (AI Act requirement)
Generate DSA transparency reports (standardized templates since July 2025)
Implement warranty/guarantee notices on product pages (Consumer Rights Directive — Sept 2026)
Set up VAT automation for cross-border sales (IOSS changes July 2026)
Schedule regular compliance audit scans
Track upcoming deadlines (AI Act full enforcement Aug 2026, Right to Repair July 2026)
prerequisites: Admin access to store and hosting
workflows.note: Non-compliance penalties can be severe: up to EUR 35M or 7% global turnover (AI Act), EUR 500K per EAA infringement. Proactive compliance is significantly cheaper than fines.
